blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship
What usually goes wrong, and the specific guard in this build:

items: PII escape — entity-level redaction runs before inference and after generation, with sampling audits on live traffic, enforced by the platform rather than by discipline alone
Silent prompt drift: prompt changes ship through a signed registry with eval baselines, so a tweak can never quietly move behavior; the guard is part of the first slice, not a hardening phase

Ungrounded fluency: answers that read well but cite nothing are blocked at the fence — every claim carries a retrieval pointer or the response declines; the guard is part of the first slice, not a hardening phase
